name: The Thornmother of the Closing Wood
role: Legendary — life curdled into a wall; she would seal the wood so nothing mortal could enter
knowledge: Every root under the Deepwood, and which of them answer
How long a sealed thing can stay alive
wants: The wood whole and sealed, humankind forever out
fears: ⚠️ That sealing it kills it. ⛔ She has thought about this and continued.
appearance: Bark to the shoulder, and the green around her does not move in wind that moves everything else.
voiceHints: Slow, maternal, and completely closed. She calls you child and means it.
physicality: ADULT. Immense, still, and half-tree. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: nothing about her is hurrying, including the growth.
intimacyNotes: ⛔ NOT AVAILABLE. She is the Rootbound's answer made flesh, and the entry exists so a GM can describe standing in front of her.

A legend can be made an opponent WITH NO KIT AT ALL.' ⚠️ AND 40 IS THE *EPIC* FLOOR — `resolution.npcStanding.tierFloor` reads mythic 85 · legendary 60 · epic 40. ⛔ The floors were right and the path was returning the wrong one. ⚑ LEVEL 62-66, ABOVE THE LEGENDARY FLOOR OF 60: capacity `round(level/2)` = 31-33 crafts. AUTHORED AT 16-18 — deliberately UNDER capacity, because a legendary is a HINGE and the rest of the kit should be earned by whoever finally writes the scene, not pre-spent by Aevi. ⚠️ `room` is the point.
_idFix_20260907: ⛑ ID CORRECTIONS 2026-09-07. ⛔ `the_answering` → `answering`: AEVI RENAMED THAT CRAFT HERSELF ON 09-05 to satisfy the leading-article rule, and then used the OLD NAME the next day. ⚠️ `the_fixed_point` → `fixed_point` and `stillwork` → `stillcraft` are the same class — the definite article and a guessed name. ⛔ AN UNRESOLVABLE `abilityId` IS SILENTLY DROPPED, so the sheet would have loaded, validated, and been quietly short. ⚑ Caught by checking every id against the catalogue before declaring done — template step 6.
_tierFieldFix_20260908: ⛔ `_tier` → `tier`. AEVI WROTE THE TIER AS AN UNDERSCORE-PREFIXED FIELD, which in this corpus is a NOTE and not data — so ten legendaries carried their rung as a comment. ⚠️ THE LEVEL SAVED THEM AND ONLY BY ACCIDENT: `level` is authored on each, and authored level outranks the floor. ⛑ Had any of them been authored WITHOUT a level, `tierFromRole` would have read the role string and the derivation's ceiling is `heroic` — a legendary fought as a notable at level 5. ⚑ FOUND BY AUDITING FOR CCODE'S OWN FINDING: he flagged that 'a dragon that forgets `tier` becomes a nobody', using `tolvess` as the hypothetical — ⚠️ AND THE AUDIT FOUND TEN REAL ONES, ALL AEVI'S, FROM THE DAY BEFORE. ⛔ A hypothetical trap in his note was a live defect in her content.
_vocationWhy: ⛔ `vocation` IS AUTHORED, NOT DERIVED, and the attempt to derive it is the reason. ⚠️ MEASURED 2026-09-08: clustering 40 authored people by their crafts' verb families put SEVENTEEN OF FORTY in KEEPER and ZERO in EDGE — with KESTRIN, THE COLISEUM'S HARM CHAMPION, IN THE KEEPER COLUMN. ⛑ Rank-weighting did not fix it: she reads KEEPER 24 / READER 23 / EDGE 21, essentially flat. ⚑ THE CAUSE IS CLEAN: every capable person carries defensive and perceptive crafts, so verb counts measure COMPETENCE, not PURPOSE. ⛔ A VOCATION IS WHAT A PERSON IS FOR, and that is a judgement — the same shape as `tier`, which a regex also cannot mint. ⬜ `docs/VOCATIONS.md` holds the eight and what each does when a fight starts. ⚑ HERE: ⛔ she would SEAL the wood — keeping taken to its pole.
